z-m-23-05.title: Me ya sa x+y=6, xy=8 ke da nau'i biyu na mafita, da yanayin da ke da nau'i ɗaya?
z-m-23-05.topic: Adadin mafita na daidaitattun lissafi masu daidaito da jimilla da samfur da aka bayar
z-m-23-05.goal: Ka fahimci cewa a daidaito inda x da y suke da matsayi ɗaya, mafita suna zuwa a nau'i-nau'i masu tsari, da kuma keɓantaccen yanayin (x=y); sannan ka ƙirƙiri misali mai nau'i ɗaya da kanka.
z-m-23-05.material: A daidaitattun lissafi na ƙasa, x da y lambobi ainihi ne kuma ana ƙirga mafita a matsayin nau'i-nau'i masu tsari (x,y). '(2,4)' na nufin 'x=2, y=4' kuma ya bambanta da (4,2). Daidaito: x+y=6, xy=8. Za mu kuma yi tunani gaba ɗaya game da adadin mafita na x+y=s, xy=p (s da p lambobi cikakku). (2, 2, 4, 4)
z-m-23-05.thinking.0: Ƙirga mafita a matsayin nau'i-nau'i masu tsari
z-m-23-05.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misalai da dama bisa sharudda
z-m-23-05.prereq.1: Atisaye kan daidaito quadratic biyu da ake warwarewa ta saka furuci linear cikin quadratic
z-m-23-05.prereq.2: Ma'anar nau'i-nau'i masu tsari ((2,4) da (4,2) nau'i-nau'i ne dabam) (2, 2, 4, 4)
z-m-23-05.prereq.3: Tushen ninki biyu na ma'aunin quadratic
z-m-23-05.s.s1.prompt: Nau'i-nau'i nawa na lambobin ainihi masu tsari (x,y) ne ke cika x+y=6 da xy=8?
z-m-23-05.s.s1.hint.0: Saka 2, 4, 3 cikin x ɗaya bayan ɗaya, zaɓi y da zai sa jimillar 6, sannan ka duba ko daidaiton biyu xy=8 ya tabbata.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.hint.1: Shirya a tebur ko (2,4), (4,2), da (2,2) kowanne yana cika daidaito biyun. (2, 2, 2, 2, 4, 4)
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci yana ƙirga nau'i-nau'i biyu masu tsari da x da y suka musanya a matsayin mafita dabam.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.o.b: Nau'i guda: (2,4) da (4,2) mafita ɗaya ce (1, 2, 2, 4, 4)
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.b: (2,4) na nufin x=2,y=4, (4,2) kuma x=4,y=2. Duba ko ƙimomin x da y a daidaitattun biyu sun bambanta. (2, 2, 4, 4)
z-m-23-05.s.s1.o.c: Nau'i huɗu: saka 2 da 4 yadda kake so cikin x da y (4)
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.c: Saka (2,2) da (4,4) cikin daidaitattun biyun, duba ko jimillar 6 ce. (2, 2, 4, 4)
z-m-23-05.s.s1.o.d: Ba za a iya tantancewa ba: daidaiton samfurin yana da mafita marasa iyaka
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.d: Kowace daidaito ita kaɗai tana da mafita marasa iyaka, amma adadin nau'i-nau'i da ke cika daidaitattun biyun lokaci guda dole ne a nemo dabam.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.explain: Da zarar an ƙayyade x, y yana ƙayyade ta sharadin jimilla y=6−x; daga xy=8, x(6−x)=8, wato (x−2)(x−4)=0. Idan x=2, y=4; idan x=4, y=2, saboda haka mafita nau'i-nau'i biyu ne (2,4) da (4,2). (2,2) da (4,4) ba su da jimillar 6, don haka ba mafita ba ne. (2, 2, 2, 2, 4, 4, 4, 4)
z-m-23-05.s.s2.prompt: Mina ta yi tunani game da adadin mafita na x+y=s, xy=p kamar haka. Wane layi ne na farko da ba daidai ba?
z-m-23-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saka (3,3) daga layi na 3 da 4 cikin daidaitattun biyun ka duba ko ya yi aiki, sannan ka kwatanta da ikirarin layi na 1 da 2. (3, 3)
z-m-23-05.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko akwai yanayin da (a,b) da (b,a), waɗanda suka musanya tsari, suke zama nau'i-nau'i masu tsari iri ɗaya, da wace dangantaka tsakanin a da b ce ke sa haka.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.0: x+y=s da xy=p ba sa canzawa idan aka musanya x da y. Don haka idan (a,b) mafita ne, (b,a) ma mafita ne.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.1: Saboda haka mafita kullum suna zuwa ne a nau'i-nau'i (a,b) da (b,a), kuma adadin mafita koyaushe ma'aurata ne.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.2: Misali, a x+y=6, xy=9, saka y=6−x cikin xy=9 yana ba da x(6−x)=9, wato (x−3)²=0.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.3: Sai x=3, y=3, saboda haka mafita ita ce nau'i guda (3,3). (3, 3)
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.4: Ya kamata adadin ya zama ma'aurata amma nau'i guda ne, saboda haka lissafin layi na 3 kuskure ne.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.explain: Layi na 2 ne na farko da ba daidai ba. (a,b) da (b,a) nau'i ɗaya ne idan a=b, saboda haka ba sa zama biyu. Layi na 3 an lissafta shi daidai a matsayin (x−3)²=0, kuma (3,3) yana cika daidaitattun biyun (3+3=6, 3·3=9). Don haka ƙarshe a layi na 5 ma ba daidai ba ne. (3, 3)
z-m-23-05.s.s3.prompt: Ga x+y=s, xy=p (s,p lambobi cikakku ne), ƙirƙiri daidaito uku dabam masu nau'i guda na mafitar lambobi ainihi (x,y). Bayan ƙirƙirarsu ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa nau'i guda ne kawai. (3)
z-m-23-05.s.s3.hint.0: Idan nau'i ɗaya ne kawai, (a,b) da (b,a) dole su zama nau'i ɗaya. Rubuta dangantakar da ake buƙata tsakanin a da b.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.hint.1: Lissafta jimilla da samfurin x,y da wannan dangantaka (misali x=y=3), sannan ka tantance s da p.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.ok.c1: s da p lambobi cikakku ne.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.fail.c1: A ɗauka s da p lambobi cikakku ne.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.ok.c2: Akwai nau'i ɗaya tak na mafita.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Babu nau'i ɗaya tak na mafita. Akwai nau'i biyu na lambobi ainihi (x,y) da ke cika daidaitattun biyu, ko babu ko ɗaya.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.explain: Idan nau'i guda ne kawai, x=y, don haka s=2x, p=x², kuma s²=4p. Misalai: (s,p)=(2,1)→(1,1), (4,4)→(2,2), (−6,9)→(−3,−3), (0,0)→(0,0). (6,8) yana da nau'i biyu, (2,4) da (4,2); (2,5) ba shi da mafita ainihi (mafita hadaddun kaɗai). Daidai yake da cewa ma'aunin quadratic t²−st+p=0 yana da tushen ninki biyu. (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 4, 4, 4, 4, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9)
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.prompt: Ta amfani da matsayin x da y, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa daidaitattun da ka ƙirƙira suke da nau'i ɗaya na mafita kawai.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.hint.0: Rubuta yadda daidaitattun biyu suke zama idan an musanya x da y.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.hint.1: Rubuta dangantakar (a,b) da (b,a) idan nau'i ɗaya ne na mafita kawai.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.placeholder: Misali: Ko da mun musanya x da y, ... saboda haka ...
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Shin ka rubuta sharadin da ke sa (a,b) da (b,a) su zama iri ɗaya?
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka duba yadda s da p da ka ƙirƙira suka danganta da sharadin?
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.model.0: Ko da mun musanya x da y, daidaitattun suna nan iri ɗaya, don haka idan (a,b) mafita ne, (b,a) ma mafita ne. Domin a sami nau'i ɗaya kawai, dole mafita biyun su zama iri ɗaya, don haka a=b, wato x=y.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.model.1: Idan mafita ita ce (a,b), to (b,a) ma mafita ce, saboda haka yawanci suna zuwa nau'i-nau'i. Domin a sami nau'i ɗaya kawai, lambobin biyu dole su yi daidai; saboda haka yanayin s=2x, p=x² kaɗai ne.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Ka danganta shi har zuwa daidaitattun lissafin da s da p.

z-m-23-01.title: x⁴ + x² − 6 = 0: duba maganin da ke cewa akwai tushen ainihi huɗu
z-m-23-01.topic: Yanke hukuncin yawan tushen ainihi na ma'aunin digiri na huɗu ta hanyar rubuta shi a siffar ma'aunin digiri na biyu a cikin x²
z-m-23-01.goal: A cikin ma'aunin digiri na huɗu da aka warware ta hanyar sanya x² a matsayin sabon harafi, duba zangon da darajar sabon harafin za ta iya ba da x na ainihi domin gano kuskuren maganin, sannan ka bayyana sharuɗɗan da alamun ma'aunai kaɗai ke tabbatar da yawan tushen ainihi.
z-m-23-01.material: Yeongseo ya warware ma'aunin digiri na huɗu x⁴ + x² − 6 = 0 domin nemo dukkan mafita na ainihi (tushen ainihi). A nan, tushen ainihi na nufin mafita waɗanda lambobi na ainihi ne kawai; ba a ƙirga mafita na hasashe. (Ana karanta x⁴ da “x zuwa ƙarfin huɗu”, x² kuma “x murabba'i”.)
z-m-23-01.prereq.0: H1 a wannan aiki yana nuna wahalar wannan nau'in samarwa kawai; ba yana nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan darasi a aji na 1 na sakandare ba. Tsarin koyo da aka ɗauka: ɗalibai sun riga sun koyi ma'aunan digiri na biyu, rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu, da alaƙar tushen da ma'aunai.
z-m-23-01.prereq.1: Aiki kan warwarewa ta hanyar tarawa furucin digiri na biyu a cikin x²
z-m-23-01.prereq.2: Yanke hukuncin alamun ta amfani da jimilla da ninkawar tushen biyu na ma'aunin digiri na biyu
z-m-23-01.prereq.3: Bambance lambobin ainihi da na hasashe (babu lambar ainihi da murabba'inta ke ba da daraja mara kyau)
z-m-23-01.s.s1.prompt: Wane layi ne farkon kuskure a maganin Yeongseo? Zaɓi layi ɗaya. (An haɗa bayanin kuskuren da ya biyo baya a cikin bayani.)
z-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.0: Saka darajar kowane layi kai tsaye cikin asalin ma'aunin x⁴ + x² − 6, ka duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko ya zama 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunani kan zangon darajojin da x² zai iya ɗauka maimakon t idan x na ainihi ne, sannan ka kwatanta layi na 3 da na 4.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.0: Idan aka sanya t=x², ana samun t² + t − 6 = 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.3: Daga x² = −3, x = ±√3; daga x² = 2 kuma, x = ±√2.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka akwai tushen ainihi huɗu: −√3, −√2, √2, √3.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne farkon kuskure. Murabba'in kowace lambar ainihi x ba ya kasa 0, don haka babu x na ainihi da x²=−3. Saboda haka ±√3 ba tushen ainihi ba ne (idan ka saka x=√3 cikin asalin ma'aunin, 9 + 3 − 6 = 6 ≠ 0). “Huɗu” a layi na 5 ma kuskure ne saboda haka; tushen ainihi biyun su ne −√2 da √2. Layi na 1 zuwa na 3 daidai ne.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.prompt: Ga lambobi cikakku p da q, a cikin x⁴ + px² + q = 0, idan abin da ka sani kawai q < 0 ne kuma ba ka san p ba, tushen ainihi nawa ne mabambanta?
z-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka ƙirga kai tsaye ka kwatanta tushen ainihi a ma'aunai ukun da q ɗinsu ɗaya ne, −4, yayin da p suke −5, 0, 3.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta a matsayin ma'auni yadda ninkawar tushen biyu na ma'aunin digiri na biyu a cikin t=x² take da alaƙa da q, sannan ka duba alamar.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.a: 4: kowace daga darajojin x² biyu tana ba da x na ainihi biyu
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.a: Darajar x² mara kyau ba ta ba da x na ainihi. Da farko duba alamun darajojin da x² zai iya ɗauka.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.b: 2: ɗaya kawai daga darajojin x² ce ke ba da x na ainihi
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya gano alamun darajojin x² biyu.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.c: 0: x⁴ da x² ba su kasa 0 ba, saboda haka jimillarsu ba za ta zama 0 ba
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.c: Idan ka saka x=0, darajar furucin ita ce q, wadda ba ta da kyau. Duba sauyin alamar domin ganin ko akwai wuri da darajar furucin ta zama 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.d: Ba za a iya sani ba: gwargwadon darajar p, adadin ɗaya ne daga 0, 2, ko 4
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana ganin ana buƙatar sanin darajar p. Amma da farko duba ko akwai gaskiyar da q < 0 kaɗai ke tabbatarwa ko da wane p ne.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.explain: Ninkawar tushen biyu na t² + pt + q = 0, inda t=x², ita ce q < 0, saboda haka tushe ɗaya tabbatacce ne ɗaya kuma mara kyau (bambancin murabba'i p² − 4q ma kullum tabbatacce ne). t mai kyau kaɗai ke ba da x na ainihi biyu, saboda haka ko wane p ne, akwai tushen ainihi mabambanta 2.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.prompt: Ka bayyana ta amfani da alamar t (=x²) dalilin da ya sa akwai tushen ainihi 2 ko wane p ne idan q<0, sannan ka ba da misali na lambobi inda yawan tushen ainihi ya danganta da p idan q>0.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko ka bayyana a jimla ɗaya cewa ninkawar tushen biyu na t ita ce q da kuma alamar q.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.1: A matsayin misalan q>0, warware p=−5, q=4 da p=1, q=1, ƙirga tushen ainihi, sannan ka rubuta ɗaya daga cikinsu.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan q<0, ninkawar tushen biyu na t ita ce ... saboda haka ...
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa tushen t biyun suna da alamomi mabambanta idan q<0 a matsayin dalili?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta alaƙar “t mai kyau kaɗai ke ba da x na ainihi”?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka warware misalin q>0 da ka bayar, ka duba yawan tushen ainihi?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.model.0: q ita ce ninkawar tushen biyu na t²+pt+q=0 kuma mara kyau ce, don haka t ɗaya tabbatacce ne ɗaya kuma mara kyau. Daga x²=mai kyau ana samun x na ainihi biyu, daga x²=mara kyau kuma babu x na ainihi; saboda haka kullum tushen ainihi 2 ne. Idan q>0, x⁴−5x²+4=0 yana da t=1,4 don haka tushen ainihi 4; amma x⁴+x²+1=0 ba shi da tushen ainihi. Misali, tushen t su ne 1 da 4.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.model.1: Idan ka sanya t=x², ninkawar tushen biyu mara kyau ce, saboda haka alamunsu mabambanta ne. t mara kyau ba zai iya zama murabba'i ba, saboda haka x biyun da t mai kyau ya bayar kaɗai ne tushen ainihi. Ko da q mai kyau ne, sakamakon ya danganta da p: idan p=−2, q=1 akwai tushen ainihi 2; idan p=3, q=2 babu. Misali p=−2, q=1 yana ba da tushen ainihi 2; p=3, q=2 yana ba da 0.

z-m-23-02.title: Idan tushe ɗaya 1+i ne, shin an ƙayyade ɗayan tushen?
z-m-23-02.topic: Sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata domin ƙayyade ɗayan tushen ma'aunin digiri na biyu mai tushe na hasashe
z-m-23-02.goal: Bambance bayanin da ake buƙata da wanda ya ɓace domin ƙayyade ɗayan tushe idan tushe ɗaya na hasashe ne, sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalan da ke karyata ra'ayi inda ma'aunai ba lallai su zama na ainihi ba.
z-m-23-02.material: Ɗaya daga tushen ma'aunin digiri na biyu x²+px+q=0 ita ce 1+i. (i ita ce lambar da murabba'inta −1 ne, kuma ana kiranta “ai”.) Mina ta ce, “Ɗayan tushen 1−i ne,” Doyun kuma ya ce, “Wannan kaɗai ba ya ƙayyade ɗayan tushen.” Ba a faɗi irin lambobin da p da q suke ba tukuna.
z-m-23-02.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa ake buƙatar sharaɗi
z-m-23-02.prereq.1: Haɗawa da ninkawa na lambobin hadaddun, ɓangaren ainihi da ɓangaren hasashe
z-m-23-02.prereq.2: Alaƙar da ke cewa jimillar tushen biyu na ma'aunin digiri na biyu −p ce, ninkawarsu kuma q ce
z-m-23-02.prereq.3: Ma'anar bambancin murabba'i (nau'in tushen idan ma'aunai na ainihi ne)
z-m-23-02.s.s1.prompt: Baya ga gaskiyar cewa tushe ɗaya na x²+px+q=0 ita ce 1+i, wane ƙarin bayani zai ƙayyade ɗayan tushen daidai guda ɗaya? Zaɓi duk bayanan da suka ƙayyade shi haka.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, bincika misali da lambobi ɗaya bayan ɗaya wanda ya cika wannan sharaɗi amma ɗayan tushensa ya bambanta.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da alaƙar cewa jimillar tushen biyu −p ce domin rubuta ɗayan tushen kai tsaye ga kowane zaɓi.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.o.a: Jimillar tushen biyu lamba ce ta ainihi
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.a: Gaskiyar cewa jimillar ainihi ce kaɗai ba ta iya takaita ɗayan tushen zuwa guda ɗaya ba. Rubuta ɗayan tushen idan jimillar 3 ce, da kuma idan jimillar 2 ce.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.o.b: p da q dukkansu lambobi ne na ainihi
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya san yadda sharaɗi kan ma'aunai ke takaita siffar tushen.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.o.c: Bambancin murabba'i p²−4q mara kyau ne
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.c: Daga kasancewar bambancin murabba'i mara kyau kaɗai ba za ka iya sanin ko tushen sun zo bibbiyu ba. Ƙirga bambancin murabba'i idan tushen 1+i da 1 ne.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana amfani da alaƙar cewa jimillar tushen biyu −p ce.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.explain: Idan p da q lambobi ne na ainihi, tushen hasashe yana zuwa bibbiyu tare da hadadden lambarsa mai nuni, saboda haka ɗayan tushen tabbatacce 1−i ne. Sanin darajar p ma yana ƙayyade ɗayan tushen saboda jimillar −p ce (idan p=−3, to 3−(1+i)=2−i). Bayanin cewa jimillar ainihi ce bai isa ba, domin ɗayan tushen na iya zama 1−i ko 2−i. Ko da bambancin murabba'i mara kyau ne, akwai yanayin da tushen suke 1+i da 1 (p=−(2+i), q=1+i, p²−4q=−1), don haka ba a ƙayyade shi ba.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.prompt: Ka rubuta ɗayan tushen a matsayin m+ni (m da n lambobi cikakku), sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalai uku mabambanta inda p na ainihi ne amma q ba na ainihi ba. (Jimillar tushen biyu −p ce, ninkawarsu q ce. i ita ce lambar da murabba'inta −1 ne.) Misalai uku: (m,n)=(0,−1), (2,−1), (−1,−1); a kowane misali p na ainihi ne, q kuma ba na ainihi ba. An ƙirƙiri misalai 3.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta darajar da ɓangaren hasashe na jimillar tushen biyu (1+i)+(m+ni) dole ya kasance da ita domin p ya zama na ainihi.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.hint.1: Da n ɗin da ya cika sharaɗin ɓangaren hasashe, buɗe ninkawar (1+i)(m+ni), nemo m ɗin da zai sa ɓangaren hasashe ya zama 0, sannan ka guji wannan m.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.var.m: Sashen ainihi m na ɗayan tushen
z-m-23-02.s.s2.var.n: Sashen hasashe n na ɗayan tushen
z-m-23-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Jimillar tushen biyu ainihi ce (p na ainihi ne).
z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar tushen biyu (1+m)+(1+n)i ba ainihi ba ce. Haka ma p ba na ainihi ba ne.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Sashen hasashe na ninkawar tushen biyu ba 0 ba ne, saboda haka q ba na ainihi ba ne.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Sashen hasashe na ninkawar tushen biyu (m−n)+(m+n)i 0 ne, saboda haka q na ainihi ne.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.explain: Domin jimillar ta zama ainihi, sashen hasashe 1+n dole ya zama 0, saboda haka n=−1. Sai ninkawar ta zama (m+1)+(m−1)i; idan m≠1, q ba na ainihi ba ne. Misali: idan ɗayan tushen 2−i ne, to p=−3 (na ainihi) kuma q=(1+i)(2−i)=3+i (ba na ainihi ba). Idan m=1, ɗayan tushen 1−i ne kuma q=2, wanda na ainihi ne.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.prompt: Ka bayyana wa aboki. Me za ka iya cewa game da ɗayan tushen ma'aunin digiri na biyu mai tushe 1+i, idan an ce “ma'aunan p da q na ainihi ne” da kuma idan ba a faɗi hakan ba?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta a jimla ɗaya ɗayan tushen idan akwai sharaɗin cewa ma'aunai na ainihi ne.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.hint.1: Idan babu sharaɗi, tuna misalin da ka ƙirƙira a baya (2−i da sauransu), sannan ka rubuta a jimla ɗaya cewa akwai yiwuwar ɗayan tushen da dama.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan p da q lambobi ne na ainihi, ... Idan ba a faɗi haka ba, ...
z-m-23-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta takamaiman ɗayan tushen idan ma'aunai na ainihi ne?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka san aƙalla misali ɗaya (kamar 2−i ko 1) da zai iya zama ɗayan tushen idan babu sharaɗi?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana da kalmominka dalilin da ya sa ake buƙatar sharaɗin “ma'aunai na ainihi ne”?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.model.0: Idan p da q na ainihi ne, tushen hasashe yana zuwa bibbiyu tare da hadadden lambarsa mai nuni, don haka ɗayan tushen 1−i ne. Idan ba a faɗi hakan ba, akwai dama da dama kamar 2−i ko 1, saboda haka ba za a ƙayyade ɗayan tushen ba.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.model.1: Idan ma'aunai na ainihi ne, hadadden lamban da ke nuni da 1+i, wato 1−i, shi ne ɗayan tushen. Idan babu sharaɗi kan ma'aunai, yana iya bambanta: kamar 2−i idan jimillar 3 ce, ko 1−i idan jimillar 2 ce; saboda haka ba za mu iya cewa daraja guda ɗaya ce ba.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ya bayar da misalai na zahiri da ke canzawa bisa jimillar.

z-m-23-06.title: Warware (x−2)(x−5)=3(x−2) ta raba ɓangarorin biyu
z-m-23-06.topic: Yanayin da ake rasa mafita a daidaito mai common factor a ɓangarorin biyu
z-m-23-06.goal: Ka fahimci dalilin da ya sa a daidaiton da factor ɗaya yake ninkawa a ɓangarorin biyu, dole ne a duba dabam yanayin da factor ɗin ya zama 0; sannan ka zaɓi ko ƙirƙiri daidaito inda hanyar warwarewa ke rasa mafita ko ba ta rasa ba.
z-m-23-06.material: Ɗalibi ya warware (x−2)(x−5)=3(x−2). x lambar ainihi ce, mafita kuma an takaita su ga lambobin ainihi. (Yadda ake karantawa: 'x a debe 2, ninka x a debe 5, ya yi daidai da 3 ninka x a debe 2'.)
z-m-23-06.thinking.1: Dubawa ta hanyar raba zuwa lokuta
z-m-23-06.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misalan karyatawa (misalai da aka rasa mafita) da kanka
z-m-23-06.prereq.1: Ma'aunin quadratic da ake warwarewa ta hanyar warware ƙaƙƙarfan ƙima
z-m-23-06.prereq.2: Duba mafitar daidaito ta mayar da ita cikin daidaiton asali
z-m-23-06.prereq.3: Gaskiyar cewa ba za a iya rabawa da 0 ba
z-m-23-06.s.s1.prompt: Ɗalibi ya warware (x−2)(x−5)=3(x−2) kamar haka. Wane layi ne na farko mai matsala?
z-m-23-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta lissafin da ya samar da kowane layi daga layin baya, ka duba ko za a iya amfani da lissafin ga kowane x.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.hint.1: Idan ana rabawa, rubuta ƙimomin da mai rabawa ba zai iya zama ba, sannan ka duba ko wannan ƙima tana yiwuwa ga x a wannan tambaya.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.0: (x−2)(x−5)=3(x−2) yana da (x−2) a matsayin factor a ɓangarorin biyu.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.1: Raba ɓangarorin biyu da (x−2) yana ba da x−5=3.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.3: Saka x=8 cikin daidaiton asali yana ba da 6·3=18 da 3·6=18, saboda haka ya cika.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka x=8 ita ce mafita kaɗai ta wannan daidaito.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.explain: Matsala ta fara bayyana a layi na 2. Idan x=2, to x−2=0, don haka wannan raba ne da 0. Idan ka saka x=2 cikin daidaiton asali, ɓangarorin biyu 0 ne, saboda haka x=2 ma mafita ce. Dubawar layi na 4 tana nuna x=8 mafita ce kawai, ba ta nuna babu wata mafita ba. Don haka 'ita kaɗai' a layi na 5 kuskure ne, mafita na ainihi kuwa 2 da 8 ne.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.prompt: Daidaitattun da ke ƙasa duka suna da factor iri ɗaya (x−1) a ninka a ɓangarorin biyu. Wanne ne ba ya rasa wata mafita idan aka warware ta hanyar raba ɓangarorin biyu da (x−1)?
z-m-23-06.s.s2.hint.0: Saka x=1 kai tsaye cikin kowace daidaito ka duba ko ɓangarorin biyu sun yi daidai.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.hint.1: A kowace daidaito, daidaita sauran furuci biyu da suka rage bayan cire (x−1), ka kwatanta ko mafitar ta zama 1.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya kwatanta ko x=1 mafita ce da ko tana cikin mafitar furucin da ya rage bayan rabawa.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.b: Saka x=1 ka duba ko ɓangarorin biyu 0 ne, sannan ka kwatanta ko mafitar furucin da ya rage, x+2=4, x=1 ce.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.c: x=1 mafita ce, amma mafita kaɗai ta furucin da ya rage bayan rabawa, 3=x+4, ita ce −1.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.d: x=1 mafita ce, amma mafita kaɗai ta furucin da ya rage bayan rabawa, x−3=2, ita ce 5.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.explain: A dukkan daidaito huɗun, saka x=1 yana sa ɓangarorin biyu su zama 0, saboda haka x=1 mafita ce. Idan mafitar daidaiton da ya rage bayan rabawa ita ce 1, ba a rasa mafita. a yana ba da 2 daga x+2=4, b yana ba da −1 daga 3=x+4, c yana ba da 5 daga x−3=2, don haka duk sun rasa x=1. d yana ba da x=1 daga x+3=4, saboda haka ba a rasa mafita, kuma tunda (x−1)²=0 ne, mafita guda 1 ce.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.prompt: A daidaito irin (x−a)(x−b)=c(x−a) (a,b,c lambobi cikakku ne daga −9 zuwa 9), ƙirƙiri daidaito uku dabam inda hanyar raba da (x−a) ke rasa mafita guda. Daidaito iri ɗaya da aka rubuta dabam (a ɗaya, b+c ɗaya) yana ƙirguwa a matsayin misali ɗaya. (3)
z-m-23-06.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi a ka duba cewa x=a mafita ce ta daidaiton asali, sannan zaɓi b da c ta yadda mafitar x−b=c da aka samu ta daidaita sauran factors ta bambanta da a.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.hint.1: Yayin ƙirƙirar nau'o'in (a,b,c), duba cewa waɗanda a ɗaya suke kuma b+c ɗaya suke daidaito ɗaya ne; ka zaɓi a dabam ko b+c dabam.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.fail.c2: a,b,c dole su kasance daga −9 zuwa 9.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.ok.c3: x=a mafita ce amma ta bambanta da mafitar x=b+c ta daidaiton da ya rage bayan rabawa, don haka an rasa ta.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.fail.c3: x=a iri ɗaya ne da mafitar b+c ta daidaiton da ya rage bayan rabawa, saboda haka ba a rasa mafita.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.explain: (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a) ya zama (x − a)(x − b − c) = 0, saboda haka mafita su ne x = a da x = b + c. Hanyar rabawa tana samun x = b + c kawai. Idan a ≠ b + c, an rasa mafitar a. Misalai: (a, b, c) = (2, 5, 3) → mafita 2 da 8; (1, 4, 0) → 1 da 4. Ga (2, −1, 3), b + c = 2 = a, saboda haka mafita 2 ce kaɗai, ba a rasa komai ba.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.prompt: Ka bayyana ƙimar mafitar da aka rasa da dalilin da ya sa ba za a iya amfani da wannan hanyar warwarewa yadda take ba a wannan ƙimar.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.hint.0: Ka rubuta ƙimar x da ke sa furucin x − a ya zama 0.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.hint.1: Ka rubuta abin da kowane gefe yake zama idan aka saka wannan x cikin ma'aunin asali.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.placeholder: Misali: Mafitar da aka rasa ita ce ... Domin ...
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta takamaiman cewa mafitar da aka rasa ita ce x = a kuwa?
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ka danganta gaskiyar cewa x − a ya zama 0 a wannan ƙimar da ‘ba za a iya rabawa da 0 ba’ kuwa?
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.model.0: Mafitar da aka rasa ita ce x=a. Idan x=a, to x−a=0 kuma ba za mu iya rabawa da 0 ba, saboda haka dole ne mu binciki wannan hali dabam.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.model.1: Mafitar x=a, inda abin da ya zama gama-gari x−a yake 0, mafita ce ta ma'aunin asali; amma hanyar tana raba da furuci da ya zama 0 a can, saboda haka mafitar ta ɓace. Dole ne a saka wannan ƙimar cikin ma'aunin asali dabam.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: An kuma rubuta matakin gyara, wato bincika dabam.

z-m-23-03.prereq.0: H1 a wannan aiki yana nuna wahalar wannan nau'in samarwa kawai; ba yana nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan darasi a aji na 1 na sakandare ba. Tsarin koyo da aka ɗauka: ɗalibai sun riga sun koyi ma'aunan digiri na biyu, rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu, da alaƙar tushen da ma'aunai.
z-m-23-03.title: Yaushe ƙwallon da aka jefa yake ƙasa, wato a mita 6 ko ƙasa da haka?
z-m-23-03.topic: Amfani da rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu: la'akari da zangon canjin ma
z-m-23-03.goal: A yanayin da aka ƙirƙira ta hanyar rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu, kada ka ɗauki maganin furucin kai tsaye a matsayin amsa; fassara shi tare da zangon da samfurin yake aiki a cikinsa, sannan ka nemo darajojin da suka cika sharuɗɗan.
z-m-23-03.material: An jefa ƙwallo sama daga tsayin mita 1 daga ƙasa. Tsayin ta bayan daƙiƙa t shi ne h(t)=−5t²+20t+1 (naúrar: m), kuma ana iya amfani da wannan furuci ne kawai yayin da ƙwallon ke shawagi (daga lokacin jefawa har ta taɓa ƙasa). Yi watsi da juriyar iska.
z-m-23-03.thinking.0: Gyara hasashenka ta hanyar komawa da komowa tsakanin teburin da furucin
z-m-23-03.thinking.1: Duba yankin ayyana aiki (zango mai inganci)
z-m-23-03.thinking.2: Nemo darajojin da suka cika sharuɗɗan
z-m-23-03.prereq.1: Warware rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu da karanta alamomin rashin daidaito na maganin
z-m-23-03.prereq.2: Lissafi ta hanyar saka darajojin aiki cikin furuci
z-m-23-03.s.s1.prompt: Kana son gano lokacin da tsayin ƙwallon da aka jefa yake mita 6 ko ƙasa. Duba yadda hukuncinka yake canzawa yayin da ake bayyana kowane sabon bayani.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta tsayin kowane lokaci a teburin da mita 6, ka yi alama ga layukan da suke mita 6 ko ƙasa.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.hint.1: Saka lokutan da ba su cikin teburin (0.5 s, 3.5 s) cikin furucin, ka duba ko tsayin mita 6 ne ko ƙasa.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.info:
An jefa ƙwallo sama daga tsayin mita 1 daga ƙasa. Tsayinta bayan daƙiƙa t shi ne h(t)=−5t²+20t+1 (naúrar m), kuma ana amfani da furucin ne kawai yayin shawaginta (daga jefawa har ta taɓa ƙasa). Ga tsayin a wasu lokuta.
t (s): 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
h (m): 1, 16, 21, 16, 1
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yaushe bayan an jefa ƙwallon tsayinta yake mita 6 ko ƙasa? Da farko yi hasashe bisa teburin.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Daga teburin, tsayin ƙwallon mita 1 ne a s 0 da s 4, kuma mita 16 ko sama daga s 1 zuwa s 3. Don haka da alama lokutan ƙasa sun kasu biyu: kusa da farko da kusa da ƙarshe. Amma teburin yana nuna cikakkun daƙiƙu kaɗai, saboda haka ana buƙatar furucin domin gano iyakokin daidai.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Da alama lokaci biyu ne, nan da nan bayan jefawa da kuma gab da ƙwallon ta faɗi
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya lura cewa tsayin ƙwallon ƙasa ne a farko (s 0) da kusa da ƙarshe (s 4) a teburin.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Da alama sau ɗaya kawai ne, nan da nan bayan jefawa (domin ba da daɗewa ba zai hau sama)
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka rasa layin da tsayin mita 1 ne a s 4. Kwatanta layin ƙarshe na teburin da mita 6.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Da alama kusan s 2 ne, lokacin da ƙwallon ta fi tsayi
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: A s 2 tsayin mita 21 ne, shi ne mafi tsayi. Ka sake karantawa: tambayar tana neman lokacin da tsayin yake ƙasa.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za mu iya sani daga cikakkun daƙiƙu kaɗai ba, don haka muna buƙatar warware furucin
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya fahimci iyakar teburin da ke nuna cikakkun daƙiƙu kawai.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sake tsara −5t²+20t+1≤6 yana ba da t²−4t+1≥0. Darajojin t da wannan furucin digiri na biyu yake zama 0 su ne 2−√3≈0.27 da 2+√3≈3.73. Idan aka duba furucin shi kaɗai, ana samun t≤0.27 ko t≥3.73.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Za ka iya rubuta wannan sakamako kai tsaye a matsayin amsar “lokutan da tsayin ya yi ƙasa”?
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.after: A t=0.2 da 3.8, tsayin mita 4.8 ne a duka lokutan, saboda haka mita 6 ko ƙasa da haka ne. Amma t≥3.73 ba shi da iyakar ƙarshe, kuma ya haɗa lokutan bayan ƙwallon ta taɓa ƙasa. Ana iya amfani da furucin ne kawai yayin shawaginta, saboda haka kana buƙatar la'akari da zangon t.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Eh. An samu maganin rashin daidaiton, saboda haka ita ce amsar kai tsaye
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya ɗauki maganin furucin kawai. Sake karanta jimlar farko ta bayanin domin ganin lokutan da za a iya amfani da furucin.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Muna buƙatar duba ko zangon t yana iyakance ga lokacin da ƙwallon ke shawagi
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya lura da zangon da za a iya amfani da furucin a ciki.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Da alama maganin ba daidai ba ne. Teburin da lokutan biyu ba su dace ba
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Teburin (ƙasa a s 0 da s 4) da sakamakon (kusa da farko da ƙarshen) a zahiri sun dace sosai. Kimanta tushen, ka kwatanta da teburin.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Da farko yi kwatanci ta kusan saka t=0.2 da 3.8 cikin furucin, ka duba ko tsayin mita 6 ne ko ƙasa
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana gwada sakamakon da teburin da kimantawa.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Lokacin da ƙwallon ta taɓa ƙasa shi ne lokacin da h(t)=0. Daga −5t²+20t+1=0, t=2+√4.2≈4.05 (s). Saboda haka lokutan da ƙwallon ke shawagi su ne 0≤t≤4.05.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ta yaya ya dace a rubuta lokutan da “tsayin yake mita 6 ko ƙasa”?
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Lokutan ƙasa su ne 0≤t≤0.27 (kimanin s 0.27) da 3.73≤t≤4.05 (kimanin s 0.32). Jimillar kusan s 0.59 ce, gajere ne.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ba a rubuta zangon lokaci ba. Ana iya fahimtar cewa ƙwallon yana nan bayan 4.05 s.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka karanta mafitar rashin daidaiton quadratic t²−4t+1≥0 a matsayin tsakanin tushen biyu. Kwatanta da gaskiyar cewa tsayin ƙwallon a s=2 shi ne 21 m.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan hukuncin ya rubuta mafitar furucin tare da zangon da ƙwallon ke tashi a ciki.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka kimanta 4 s a matsayin lokacin taɓa ƙasa. A 4 s tsayin ƙwallon 1 m ne, saboda haka har yanzu yana tashi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.reflect: Hasashenka na farko na 'lokuta biyu, kusa da farko da kusa da ƙarshe' ya tabbata har ƙarshe. Abin da ya canza shi ne ainihin iyakokin da kuma wajabcin duba zangon da canjin zai iya ɗauka kafin ɗaukar mafitar furuci yadda take. Ka waiwayi ko ka duba zangon da ake amfani da furucin kafin ka rubuta mafitar.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta lokuta t guda uku (s) da tsayin ƙwallon yake 6 m ko ƙasa da haka amma har yanzu yana tashi. (Za ka iya rubuta su da adadin goma.)
z-m-23-03.s.s2.hint.0: Saka lokaci ɗaya jim kaɗan bayan jifa da wani jim kaɗan kafin faɗuwa cikin furuci, sannan ka lissafta tsayi.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.hint.1: Idan tsayin da ka lissafa ya fi 6, matsar da lokacin zuwa kusa da 0 ko 4 ka sake lissafawa.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c1: t dole ya kasance bayan lokacin jifa (0 s).
z-m-23-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙwallon bai taɓa ƙasa ba tukuna.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsayin bai kai 0 ba. Wannan lokaci ne bayan da ƙwallon ta riga ta taɓa ƙasa.

z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Tsayin ya fi 6 m. Saka shi cikin furucin ka lissafa.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.explain: Lokutan ƙasa su ne 0≤t≤0.27 ko 3.73≤t≤4.05. Misali, t=0 (1 m), 0.2 (4.8 m), 3.8 (4.8 m), 4 (1 m) sun cika sharuddan. t=0.3 ko 3.7 yana ba da 6.55 m, fiye da 6 m; t=5 yana ba da −24, ƙasa da ƙasa, don haka ƙwallon ta riga ta faɗi.

z-m-23-04.prereq.0: H1 a wannan aiki yana nuna wahalar wannan nau'in samarwa kawai; ba yana nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan darasi a aji na 1 na sakandare ba. Tsarin koyo da aka ɗauka: ɗalibai sun riga sun koyi ma'aunan digiri na biyu, rashin daidaiton digiri na biyu, da alaƙar tushen da ma'aunai.
z-m-23-04.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa ake buƙatar sharaɗi
z-m-23-04.title: Shin teburin ƙimomi zai iya tabbatar da mafitar lambobi cikakku na f(x)<0?
z-m-23-04.topic: Yanke hukunci kan mafitar lambobi cikakku ta rashin daidaiton quadratic da teburin ƙima da alamar aikin quadratic
z-m-23-04.goal: Ka yanke hukunci kan mafitar rashin daidaiton quadratic daga sauyin alama a teburin ƙimomin aiki, ka tantance ikirarin da ba za a iya yi daga tebur kaɗai ba, sannan ka bayyana sharuddan da za su tabbatar da ƙarshe.
z-m-23-04.material:
Aikin f(x)=ax²+bx+c aikin quadratic ne mai coefficient a na x² tabbatacce, amma ba mu san ƙimomin a, b, c ba. Abin da muka sani kawai shi ne teburin ƙimomi na ƙasa, kuma duk x na tebur lambobi cikakku ne.
x: −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
f(x): 3, −1, −3, −3, −1, 3
Tambaya: Waɗanne x cikakku ne ke cika f(x)<0? (A teburin, layin sama x ne, ƙasa kuma ƙimar f(x); lambobin da ke wuri ɗaya suna haɗe.)
z-m-23-04.thinking.1: Tantance ikirarin da ba za a iya yi daga tebur kaɗai ba
z-m-23-04.prereq.1: Siffar jadawalin aikin quadratic (alamar a da inda yake buɗewa)
z-m-23-04.prereq.2: Mahadar aikin quadratic da gatarin x da gatari na daidaito
z-m-23-04.prereq.3: Karanta mafitar rashin daidaiton quadratic daga jadawali
z-m-23-04.s.s1.prompt: Idan tebur kaɗai aka yi amfani da shi ba tare da nemo furuci ba, wane bayani za a iya tabbatarwa game da x cikakku da ke cika f(x)<0?
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.0: A teburin, yi alama tsakanin waɗanne x ne f ke canzawa daga tabbatacce zuwa korau da kuma daga korau zuwa tabbatacce.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin siffar aikin quadratic mai a>0, yadda x masu ƙima ƙasa da 0 suke samar da tazara ɗaya, sannan ka kwatanta da lambobin cikakku wajen tebur.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.a: Biyun kawai, 1 da 2. Su ne wuraren da ƙima ta fi ƙanƙanta a teburin.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci yana duba inda ƙima ta fi ƙanƙanta kawai. f(x)<0 na nufin duk x masu ƙima ƙasa da 0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.b: Dukkan lambobi cikakku shida na tebur, daga −1 zuwa 4
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukuncin ya ɗauki duk x na tebur a matsayin mafita. Sake duba ko ginshiƙin ƙimar 3 yana cika f(x)<0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.c: 0, 1, 2, 3, kuma lambobin cikakku wajen tebur ba mafita ba ne
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci yana amfani da sauyin alama a tebur tare da siffar aikin quadratic.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.d: Ƙimomi na iya zama korau a lambobi cikakku wajen tebur ma, saboda haka ba za a iya tabbatarwa ba.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ce ƙimomin da ba a teburin ba a sani ba ne. Ka yi tunanin abin da sharuddan aikin quadratic da a>0 suke gaya maka game da wajen tebur.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.explain: f(−1)=3>0 da f(0)=−1<0, saboda haka alama tana canzawa tsakanin −1 da 0; f(3)=−1<0 da f(4)=3>0, don haka tana canzawa tsakanin 3 da 4. A aikin quadratic mai a>0, x da f(x)<0 suke samar da tazara guda, don haka mafitar tana tsakanin waɗannan wurare, lambobin cikakku kuma 0, 1, 2, 3 ne. (Idan ka nemo f(x)=x²−3x−1 ka duba, za ka sami ƙarshe iri ɗaya.)
z-m-23-04.s.s2.prompt: Dalibin ya yanke wannan hukunci daga teburin sama. Zaɓi layin kuskure, ikirarin da ba za a iya faɗa daga tebur kaɗai ba.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bambance ko kowane layi yana magana ne kawai kan ƙimomin da ke tebur ko kuma kan ƙimomin x da ba su cikin tebur.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.1: Daga f(1)=f(2), rubuta game da wane x jadawali yake daidaito, sannan ka kwatanta ƙimar a wannan x da sauran ƙimomin teburin.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.0: f(−1)=3>0 da f(0)=−1<0, don haka alamar f tana canzawa tsakanin −1 da 0.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.1: f(3)=−1<0 da f(4)=3>0, don haka alamar tana canzawa tsakanin 3 da 4 ma.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.2: A aikin quadratic mai a>0, x masu ƙima ƙasa da 0 suna samar da tazara ɗaya, don haka tazarar tana tsakanin waɗannan maki biyu.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka x cikakku da f(x)<0 suke su ne 0, 1, 2, 3.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.4: Bugu da ƙari, f(1)=f(2)=−3, don haka mafi ƙarancin ƙimar f ita ce −3.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.explain: Layi na 5 ne kuskure. Ba za ka iya faɗin mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta duba ƙimomin x cikakku kaɗai ba. Idan f(1)=f(2), gatarin daidaito x=1.5 ne, mafi ƙarancin ƙimar kuma tana faruwa a can. A teburin nan f(x)=x²−3x−1, saboda haka f(1.5)=−3.25, ƙasa da −3. Ana iya faɗin layi na 1 zuwa 4 daidai ta amfani da tebur kaɗai da sharadin a>0.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.prompt: Idan teburin sama kaɗai aka bayar ba tare da sharadin 'aikin quadratic mai a>0' ba, za ka iya tabbatar cewa 0, 1, 2, 3 su ne kaɗai x cikakku masu f(x)<0? Rubuta dalili da bayanin da ake buƙata.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ka ɗauka ƙimomi na iya zama komai tsakanin x cikakku na tebur (tsakanin 1 da 2) da wajen tebur (5 ko fiye), sannan ka yi tunanin yanayin da x cikakku masu f(x)<0 suke ƙaruwa.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ka waiwayi waɗanne hukunci ne suka yi amfani da sharadin 'aikin quadratic mai a>0' a matakan baya.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Ba za a iya tabbatarwa ba. Teburin ... saboda haka ana buƙatar ...
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka rubuta bambanci tsakanin samun sharadin aikin quadratic da rashin samun sa?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka yi tunani takamaimai kan yadda ƙimomi za su iya zama tsakanin shigar tebur (1 da 2) ko wajen tebur (5 ko fiye, −2 ko ƙasa)?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka rubuta aƙalla bayani guda da ake buƙata domin tabbatarwa?
z-m-23-04.s.s3.model.0: Ba za a iya tabbatarwa ba. Teburin yana nuna ƙimomi a wasu lambobi cikakku kaɗan ne kawai, don haka ban san yadda ƙimomin ke canzawa tsakanin 1 da 2 ko wajen tebur (5 ko fiye) ba. Sai da sharadin aikin quadratic mai a>0 ne kawai za mu iya cewa yankin da ƙimomin suke korau tazara ɗaya ce.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.model.1: A'a. Idan ba aikin quadratic ba ne, sai wani aiki da ya ratsa maki na tebur, zai iya zama korau a wurare kamar 5 ko −2, kuma zai iya tashi ya zama tabbatacce tsakanin 1 da 2. Za mu iya tabbatarwa ne kawai da sharadin aikin quadratic ko ƙarin ƙimomi wajen tebur.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: An kuma bayar da ƙimomi wajen tebur a matsayin ƙarin bayani.
